verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs state that clipboard history is provided by the bundled Walker launcher, works for both text and images, and opens with a single hotkey (Super + Ctrl + V), alongside unified clipboard hotkeys that work almost everywhere. That covers every element of the story, but only through brief first-party mentions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of history depth or behavior such as retention, search and pasting images back.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can access a unified clipboard history across text and images with one hotkey

citations.quote: The clipboard history is provided by Walker and works for both text and images. You trigger it by `Super + Ctrl + V`
